notes.v110.session.title: Session Recap
notes.v110.session.text: A new box shows your rating when the session started and now, and your latest matches with the hero, the place and the rating change. It shows in a match and on the Battlegrounds menu. Right-click it to start a new session.
notes.v110.layout.title: One column by the leaderboard
notes.v110.layout.text: The lobby minion types, the sidebar and the Session Recap now stand as one column left of the leaderboard. With two-line rows the boxes stay narrow and the text gets larger. A long name is cut off instead of being written smaller.
notes.v110.ready.title: Ready-made configs
notes.v110.ready.text: The Config page has ready-made setups: the toolkit's own default, and versions for players who run Firestone or Hearthstone Deck Tracker beside it, which turn off what that app already shows.
notes.v110.lobbytypes.title: Lobby minion types, your way
notes.v110.lobbytypes.text: Lay the lobby types box out as one row, one column, two rows or three rows. Show icons, names or both, and see the season's banned types crossed out.
notes.v110.sizes.title: Size what's by the portraits
notes.v110.sizes.text: Two sliders set the size of the name and MMR plate and of the tier and minion type icons by the leaderboard portraits, with a picture that follows as you drag.
notes.v110.bell.title: The bell
notes.v110.bell.text: A bell next to the in-game search button turns green when a new version is out and yellow for new patch notes. The bell and the search button can be moved and resized like the other boxes.
notes.v110.mods.title: BepInEx mods
notes.v110.mods.text: See the mods from hsbg.cards, which of them you have and at which version, and open their Setup in one click. New in the list: Tantrum's Board Fix, which keeps your board from jumping around.
notes.v110.ukrainian.title: Ukrainian
notes.v110.ukrainian.text: The toolkit's menus, panels and Setup are now also in Ukrainian. Cards and the card search stay in English.
notes.v110.matchdata.title: Community stats
notes.v110.matchdata.text: After each Solos match the toolkit sends a short report to hsbg.cards, with no names in it. Everyone's matches add up to community statistics of heroes, minion types and places. You can turn it off here.
